id.description: NHC storm identifier, such as AL112017.

binNumber.description: NHC advisory slot, such as AT1.

name.description: Name or designation used by NHC.

basin.description: Basin indicated by the storm ID.

advisoryNumber.description: Public advisory number with any intermediate advisory suffix.

issuanceTime.description: Public advisory issuance time in UTC.

lat.description: Center latitude in decimal degrees north.

lon.description: Center longitude in decimal degrees east.

intensityKmh.description: Maximum sustained wind converted to kilometers per hour.

pressureMb.description: Central mean sea level pressure in millibars.

movementDirDeg.description: Movement bearing in degrees clockwise from true north.

movementSpeedMph.description: Movement speed in miles per hour.

publicAdvisoryUrl.description: Link to the NHC public or intermediate advisory.

forecastAdvisoryUrl.description: Link to the latest NHC forecast advisory, when linked.

forecastTrackUrl.description: Link to the NHC forecast track ZIP, when linked.

forecastTrack.description: NHC forecast points in UTC time order. Null when the track is missing or could not be loaded. Omitted when disabled.

lat.description: Forecast center latitude in decimal degrees north.

lon.description: Forecast center longitude in decimal degrees east.

maxWindKt.description: Forecast maximum sustained wind in knots.

classification.description: NHC development classification from the forecast point table.

forecastTrackError.description: Brief error message when a linked forecast ZIP could not be fetched or parsed.
